lines.text: The biggest desert on Earth isn't hot.
It's not the Sahara. And the reason why is even stranger.
A desert isn't about heat. It's about how little falls from the sky.
Less than two hundred fifty millimeters of rain or snow a year makes a desert.
lines.caption: Less than 250 mm of rain or snow a year makes a desert.

lines.text: Much of Antarctica's interior gets only about fifty.
lines.caption: Much of Antarctica's interior gets only about 50.

lines.text: And at fourteen million square kilometers, it beats the Sahara's nine.
lines.caption: And at 14 million km², it beats the Sahara's ~9.

lines.text: Sounds fake? It's true. Follow for more.
